title: Detective Comics #599 DC April 1989 Batman Blind Justice Part 2 Sam Hamm
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Detective Comics #599 (April 1989), DC Comics. Batman in "Blind Justice" Part 2 of 3, written by Sam Hamm (screenwriter of the 1989 Batman movie), art by Denys Cowan and Dick Giordano. Batman 50th anniversary logo on the cover. 75c cover price.

Back cover: Acclaim WWF WrestleMania Nintendo/VCR game ad with Hulk Hogan.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
